Atomic node skill to exclusively update the start and end time of a Google Calendar event.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Google Calendar Update Time skill:

- Adds an atomic skill to update only the start and end time of an existing Google Calendar event.
- Uses the `gog` CLI for precise, standardized updates.
- Does not modify event title, location, or attendees.
- Includes automatic error detection and validation to ensure accurate updates.
- Returns a JSON object confirming the changes.
